alternatives.description: Windows outer launcher, WSL Linux supervisor plus one disposable child; separate cleanup-only WSL process verifies identities and persistent launch fence. Covers startup and collects physical receipts.
Only WSL/Linux supervisor with Windows merely waiting; simpler but omits independently bounded WSL startup/capture and identity verification after lost parent output. Not selected.

single_control.source: Real SourceFileLoader with exact synthetic fixture
single_control.denial: One exact pyc open -> PermissionError absorbed by CPython OSError branch
single_control.journal: Original copied PreopenedJournal, os.write and fsync profile return plus physical JSONL equality
single_control.next_action: Trivial counter callback must stay0 after post-import checkpoint; final checkpoint remains latched
single_control.instrumentation: audit.__cantrace__ True; sys.setprofile observes builtins, no monkeypatch

identity_and_claims.windows: CLAIM.json exclusive+fsync+readback before wsl.exe; nonce + exact contract/auth
identity_and_claims.linux: LINUX_CLAIM before child spawn; exact argv/PID/start_ticks/boot_id/exe retained
identity_and_claims.child: CASE_CLAIM before guard exec, fixture, hook, journal; parent PID/nonce/start_ticks matches /proc
identity_and_claims.no_replay: Existing CLAIM/RUN/RESULT rejects entry; failed/incomplete unit terminal
identity_and_claims.cleanup: STOP durable + launch gate flock; exact argv/request/nonce/exe only; pidfd opens before identity check and signal; no taskkill, pkill, wsl terminate or broad group kill
identity_and_claims.delayed_launch: STOP check under same gate before Popen prevents delayed supervisor launching after cleanup fence
identity_and_claims.absence_scope: No live controlled identities at final inspected /proc instant under gate; not absolute system-wide absence, not hostile-code confinement or proof across later unrelated actions
identity_and_claims.inspection_failure: Foreign UID processes excluded; PermissionError inspecting a same-UID process fails cleanup visibly as uncertain, never silently skipped.

read_write_scope.before_hook: Only this prepared package/contract/auth/review/claims, pinned stdlib/runtime, own /proc identity and controlled-process metadata; synthetic fixture outputs only Three exact RUN/ARGV_SUPERVISOR.json, ARGV_CLEANUP.json and ARGV_CHILD.json metadata receipts use the existing exclusive writer before control; no data series are read.
read_write_scope.after_hook_writes: preopened journal/result FD + stdout/stderr; new write opens refused
read_write_scope.compile_exec: Only exact synthetic fixture filename after hook; no imports except probe_fixture
read_write_scope.forbidden: Scientific imports/files, LAL/numpy/bilby/dynesty/source/driver/sampler, D/PE/waveform/likelihood, remote calls/network/subprocess descendants; scientific allowlists unchanged

argv_transport.destination_representation: PurePosixPath absolute literal shared across Windows and Linux; as_posix yields the transported script token. Native Path handles IO only.
argv_transport.spaces: Remain in one list element; no split, shell string, manual embedded quotes or URL encoding
argv_transport.runtime_observation: Before any hook/control or cleanup signal, receiver reads its own /proc PID/cmdline via existing proc_identity and captures list(sys.argv); no observations manufactured by parent.
argv_transport.expected: argv_for(role,nonce); full process argv includes interpreter and flags; sys.argv equals expected[6:].
argv_transport.receipt_write: fresh exclusive+fsync+readback before equality validation; a mismatch leaves diagnostic evidence and raises before the control. Failure before observation remains visible but may lack this receipt.
argv_transport.binding: Same process identity snapshot retained in role claim/result; child PID and parent links remain checked. Parent reads physical argv receipt, recomputes exact expectations and requires equality; flags alone never suffice.
argv_transport.final_receipts: CASE_RESULT, LINUX_RESULT, CLEANUP_RESULT carry argv_transport; Windows RESULT nests Linux and cleanup records.
argv_transport.validation_failure: Nonzero/exception, no PASS and no retry; existing identity-bound cleanup rules remain in force.
argv_transport.future_transport_acceptance: Only actual received argv from future authorized run, matching expected full and script argv at all three roles, counts as transport evidence. Static expected examples do not.

invocation_budget_interpretation: windows_wsl_invocations=2 is a maximum: at most one primary plus one cleanup-only invocation, and at most one control child. No additional argv receiver process or extra campaign.
